lines.1: 「All right. I hereby call today's student council meeting to order.」
lines.2: 「I have a general sense of what all four of you can do, so I will assign your posts now.」
lines.6: 「Yes. Otome is both head of the disciplinary committee and a student council vice president, so have her teach you the job.」
lines.7: 「Rest assured, Princess. I will educate him thoroughly.」
lines.8: Somehow, Otome was already planted beside me in an imposing stance.
lines.9: I had no idea why, but she looked incredibly motivated.
lines.11: 「Crabby, you will be an accounting auditor. Fukahire will hold the same post.」
lines.13: 「You check whether the accounting is being handled fairly.」
lines.14: 「I currently serve as treasurer too, so frankly, there is almost no work for you.」
lines.15: 「I thought that would suit Crabby and Fukahire, since you're both still more interested in playing.」
lines.16: 「Sounds good to me. Honestly, I don't want anything too annoying. I'll take it.」
lines.17: 「I'd do a tougher job if it was for you, Princess.」
lines.18: 「No. I doubt you would be much use at a difficult job, so this is fine.」
lines.19: 「Got it. Then I'll work hard at this one!」
lines.21: In his own way, this guy was amazing.
lines.22: 「Subaru, you will assist Yoppi as secretary.」
lines.24: 「You seem rough, but you're actually quite meticulous.」
lines.25: 「Hah. I see. You've got us figured out.」
lines.27: 「Now, I will have you begin work immediately.」
lines.29: 「What kind of work does the student council do?」
lines.30: 「We've never had anything to do with it before, so we wouldn't know.」
lines.32: 「Planning and running school events, processing petitions, executing the budget, coordinating and assisting the various committees... It is quite a lot of work.」
lines.33: 「Some of the petitions are practically requests for life advice.」
